text:
morgan: Heads up — I'm prototyping a new runtime metrics dashboard (tail latency, kv-cache hit ratio, queue depth + scale events). Need input on alert thresholds, SLO burn mapping, and pager routing. Ping infra + oncall.

sanjay: SG. Do we have baseline p50/p95/p99 numbers for gpu-prod? I think p99 sits around 450ms normally.

caroline: From infra side: we can add per-pool queue_depth + active_shards metrics. Rule of thumb: prefer sustained-window alerts (>=5m) to reduce flapping.

morgan: Initial proposal: p99 > 700ms sustained 5m -> Sev2 page; p99 > 2000ms sustained 3m -> Sev1 page. kv-cache miss ratio > 10% sustained 10m -> Sev2. queue_depth > 50 (per-pool) for 5m -> Sev2. Open to tuning.

kai: Quick context on routing: Sev1 pages primary infra oncall (24/7). Sev2 pages runtime during business hours and creates an async ticket after hours. If SLO burn is high we should escalate.

caroline: Agree to routing. Suggest we use a burn-rate suppression: only page if burn_rate > 4x for a 30m window (so single short spikes don't page).

sanjay: Also want to avoid pages during autoscaler churn. Proposed suppression: if scale_events > 0 in last 5m, mute the automated page and surface a dashboard banner instead.

morgan: Example alert expression (proto):
```
# p99 latency (pseudo-promql)
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, pool)) > 0.7
# and only page if scaler not active
AND max_over_time(scaler_activity_total[5m]) == 0
```

caroline: Small nit: avoid using absent(...) here, use max_over_time(...) == 0 or sum_over_time(...) == 0 to be explicit.

kai: For SLO burn alerts we should use the burn-rate math in alertmanager, e.g.: burn = increase(error_count[5m]) / increase(request_count[5m]) and trigger when burn > SLO_target * burn_multiplier. We'll set multipliers: 1.5 for warning, 4 for page.

morgan: Action items: 1) @sanjay add Prometheus rules for p99, kv-miss, queue-depth with suppression logic. 2) @caroline update routing map -> Sev1->infra, Sev2->runtime. 3) @kai author oncall playbook with triage checklist and escalations.

runbook-bot: New runbook created: /runbooks/runtime-latency -> https://wiki.internal/runbooks/runtime-latency :white_check_mark:

sanjay: I'll open a PR with rule drafts and include testcases for scale suppression, will CC @morgan and @caroline. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

morgan: :thumbsup: thanks. Also add panels for 'recent deploys' and 'scale events' to the dashboard so oncall can triage faster.

kai: :eyes: add a link to release tags in the dashboard. Also recommend a dry-run using alertmanager 'testsend' to validate routing without waking people.

caroline: Updated routing doc draft: https://docs.redwood/ops/alert-routing — comments welcome.

morgan: Closing loop: once PR lands, let's schedule a controlled dry-run next Tue 10:00 to verify pages and playbook steps. I'll create the calendar invite.

kai: Acked. I'll prepare the playbook snippet for 'scale-related latency' and drop it into the runbook.

morgan: Thanks all — good progress. We'll keep this thread for followups and PR links.
